validity_days_range: Enter the validity in days (1-3650) or leave it empty
adjust_delta: Enter a number of sessions, e.g. 1 or -1
amount_positive: The amount must be greater than zero
amount_invalid: Enter a valid amount, e.g. 800 or 800.50
sale_name_or_template: Enter a package name or choose a template
sale_sessions_or_template: Enter the number of sessions or choose a template
sale_price_or_template: Enter a price or choose a template
days_range_365: Enter a number of days from 1 to 365
beta_label: Enter who the code is for (e.g. name and school)
birth_date_future: The birth date can’t be in the future
balance_below_zero: The balance can’t go below zero
trainer_busy: The trainer already has a session at that time. Choose another time or another trainer.
charge_settled: This charge is already paid or canceled
password_same_as_old: The new password must differ from the current one
reason_required: A reason is required when blocking access
password_min: The password must be at least {min} characters
password_max: The password can be at most {max} characters
accept_terms: Tick the box to create an account
